I'll look through your notes and memory for anything called open-door notes.The open-door notes are the MiniGrid DoorKey write-up in `gut_minigrid_001/PROTOCOL_DOUBT.md`: confirm world 2613102 learned that moving forward depends only on the cell type in front, because it had only seen closed doors block the way, so it never tried an open door and stayed at 0% success. The fix (`MG_DOUBT=1`) is to try a prediction whose exact feature combination was never observed once no plan reaches the goal and nothing is plainly unknown. That world went from 0% to 100% only as a diagnostic, and fresh seeds 2613200–205 then passed, with every world’s last training window at 100% and new 6×6 and 8×8 layouts solved with no exploration.

CONFIDENCE: 72
